description: A scoped formula all of whose nonlogical symbols belong to the old language is recursively restricted to an actual old-language formula with the same free and bound contexts.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.stripFormula.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ} {α : Type z}
  {k : ℕ} (A : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubled L n).BoundedFormula α k) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.OldOnly
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols A) →
    L.BoundedFormula α k
